preconditions.expression: all(c in {'4', '7'} for c in N)
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string N must be either '4' or '7'.
The length of the input string N must be between 1 and 49 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for length in range(1, len(N) + 1) for _ in range(2 ** length)) + int(N, 8) - 1
postconditions.description: The returned position is the 1-based index of the string N in the series, where the series is ordered by length (ascending) and lexicographical order (ascending) for each length. The formula accounts for all numbers of shorter lengths (each length has 2^length numbers) and the position of N within its length group (interpreted as an octal number).
